subject: English Home Language

source.topic: My senses: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'v' sound at the beginning of words

show.line: Listen. v as in vuvuzela. v, v, vuvuzela. Your teeth touch your lip!

rounds.prompt: Listen with your ears. Which one starts with v?
Say the sound with me. v, as in van!

rounds.story: Vusi plays his vuvuzela. Toot! His sister plays a violin. What does his sister play?

rounds.prompt: Smell the flowers! Which one starts with v?
What is this? It starts with v.
Does it start with v? Put v words in the v group.

hints: Listen for v at the start. v, v, van.
Put your teeth on your lip and hum. vvv.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with v.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Drum starts with d. Vuvuzela starts with v.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. v, v, vuvuzela. That starts with v!

parent_line: Can hear the v sound at the start of words.
